definitions.explanation: A pungent green condiment made from the grated rhizome of the wasabi plant, commonly served with sushi and sashimi.

examples.japanese: {山葵|わさび}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧。
⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{山葵|わさび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{山葵|わさび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}き→効く：01932_kiku⟧⟦すぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The wasabi was too strong and I got teary-eyed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：noentry⟧{山葵|わさび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{練|ね}り→練る：09751_neru⟧{山葵|わさび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Real wasabi is expensive, so many restaurants use wasabi paste.

notes:
USAGE:
- Most "wasabi" served in restaurants outside Japan (and even in many Japanese restaurants) is actually colored horseradish (⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧わさび).
- ⟦{本|ほん}→本：noentry⟧わさび refers to authentic wasabi from the wasabi plant.
- Fresh wasabi is grated on a ⟦{鮫皮|さめかわ}おろし→さめかわおろし：noentry⟧ (sharkskin grater).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山葵|わさび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to add wasabi)
- {山葵|わさび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (wasabi is hot/strong)
- {山葵|わさび}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧ (without wasabi)
- ⟦{練|ね}り→練る：09751_neru⟧{山葵|わさび} (wasabi paste)
